title: Prevent: помешать действию
description: Prevent: помешать действию: словарь, грамматическая модель и авторский текст с разбором смысла и объяснениями ответов.
notes: Prevent someone from entering — помешать кому-либо войти.
После from используется -ing; контекст уточняет, чьё действие было предотвращено.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: A locked gate prevented us ___ entering.
exercises.explanation: Prevent someone from doing — целевая модель.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: using / use.

public_payload.sentence: The barrier prevented cars from ___ the path.

exercises.editorial_answer: The barrier prevented cars from using the path.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Преграда не позволила машинам въехать.»
exercises.editorial_answer: The barrier prevented cars from entering.
exercises.explanation: Prevented from entering описывает предотвращённый въезд.

public_payload.passage: A barrier prevented cars from entering the narrow path, but pedestrians could still use a side gate. The first notice described the path as completely inaccessible. A walker asked for a correction because that wording included people the barrier had not stopped. The revised notice distinguished vehicle access from pedestrian access and explained where walkers could enter safely.
